mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (account_no, name, balance, bank_id) VALUES (#{accountNo}, #{name}, #{balance}, #{bankId})
mapper.select: SELECT account_no, name, balance, bank_id FROM account WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}
SELECT account_no, name, balance, bank_id FROM account ORDER BY account_no
SELECT account_no, name, balance, bank_id FROM account WHERE name = #{name} ORDER BY account_no
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET name = #{name} WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}
UPDATE account SET balance = balance + #{amount} WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}
UPDATE account SET balance = balance - #{amount} WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND balance >= #{amount}
mapper.select: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID, TRANSACTION_DATETIME, KIND, AMOUNT, BALANCE, ACCOUNT_NO FROM "TRANSACTION" WHERE ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo} ORDER BY TRANSACTION_DATETIME DESC
